title: Automação Completa de Servidor Web com Ansible
description: Construa um playbook Ansible completo para automatizar a implantação, configuração e hardening de segurança de servidores web em múltiplos ambientes.
prerequisites: Acesso SSH aos servidores de destino
Compreensão dos conceitos de servidor web
learningObjectives: Usar roles e variáveis do Ansible de forma eficaz

steps.title: Estrutura do Projeto e Configuração do Inventário
steps.description: Crie uma estrutura de projeto Ansible adequada com arquivos de inventário e variáveis de grupo.
steps.codeExample:
# ansible.cfg
[defaults]
inventory = inventory/hosts.yml
host_key_checking = False
remote_user = ubuntu
private_key_file = ~/.ssh/id_rsa
roles_path = roles
retry_files_enabled = False
stdout_callback = yaml

[privilege_escalation]
become = True
become_method = sudo
become_user = root
become_ask_pass = False

# inventory/hosts.yml
all:
  children:
    webservers:
      hosts:
        web1:
          ansible_host: 192.168.1.10
          server_name: web1.example.com
        web2:
          ansible_host: 192.168.1.11
          server_name: web2.example.com
    databases:
      hosts:
        db1:
          ansible_host: 192.168.1.20
  vars:
    ansible_user: ubuntu
    ansible_become: yes
hints: Ajuste os endereços IP conforme o seu ambiente
Garanta que a autenticação por chave SSH esteja configurada
Teste a conectividade com ansible all -m ping
validationCriteria: A estrutura de diretórios do projeto foi criada
O arquivo de configuração do Ansible está devidamente configurado
O arquivo de inventário contém os hosts de destino
A conectividade SSH com os hosts foi verificada

steps.title: Configurar Variáveis de Grupo e Templates
steps.description: Configure variáveis de grupo para diferentes ambientes e crie templates de configuração do Nginx.
steps.codeExample:
# group_vars/webservers.yml
---
nginx_version: latest
nginx_user: www-data
nginx_worker_processes: auto
nginx_worker_connections: 1024
nginx_keepalive_timeout: 65
nginx_client_max_body_size: 100M

# SSL Configuration
ssl_cert_path: /etc/ssl/certs
ssl_key_path: /etc/ssl/private
ssl_cert_file: "{{ server_name }}.crt"
ssl_key_file: "{{ server_name }}.key"

# Security settings
firewall_allowed_ports:
  - 22
  - 80
  - 443

# Application settings
app_user: webuser
app_group: webuser
app_directory: /var/www/html
document_root: "{{ app_directory }}"

# Environment-specific overrides
environments:
  production:
    nginx_worker_processes: 4
    ssl_protocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
    error_log_level: warn
  staging:
    nginx_worker_processes: 2
    ssl_protocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
    error_log_level: info
  development:
    nginx_worker_processes: 1
    ssl_protocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
    error_log_level: debug
hints: Use templates Jinja2 para configuração dinâmica
Mantenha dados sensíveis em arquivos criptografados separados
validationCriteria: O arquivo de variáveis de grupo foi criado
As variáveis cobrem configurações de nginx, SSL e segurança
As configurações específicas de cada ambiente estão definidas
O diretório de templates está preparado

steps.title: Criar o Playbook Principal de Implantação
steps.description: Construa o playbook principal que orquestra toda a implantação e configuração do servidor web.
steps.codeExample:
# playbooks/web-setup.yml
---
- name: Complete Web Server Setup and Configuration
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    ansible_env: "{{ env | default('development') }}"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Update package cache (Debian/Ubuntu)
      apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Update package cache (RedHat/CentOS)
      yum:
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install required packages
      package:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        state: present
      loop:
        - curl
        - wget
        - unzip
        - openssl
        - ca-certificates

  tasks:
    - name: Create application user
      user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: yes
        shell: /bin/false
        home: "{{ app_directory }}"
        create_home: yes

    - name: Install Nginx
      package:
        name: nginx
        state: present

    - name: Ensure Nginx service is enabled
      systemd:
        name: nginx
        enabled: yes

    - name: Create SSL directories
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'
        owner: root
        group: root
      loop:
        - "{{ ssl_cert_path }}"
        - "{{ ssl_key_path }}"

    - name: Generate self-signed SSL certificate (for demo)
      command: >
        openssl req -new -nodes -x509
        -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=San Francisco/O=IT/CN={{ server_name }}"
        -days 365
        -keyout {{ ssl_key_path }}/{{ ssl_key_file }}
        -out {{ ssl_cert_path }}/{{ ssl_cert_file }}
      args:
        creates: "{{ ssl_cert_path }}/{{ ssl_cert_file }}"

    - name: Set SSL certificate permissions
      file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ ssl_cert_path }}/{{ ssl_cert_file }}", mode: '0644' }
        - { path: "{{ ssl_key_path }}/{{ ssl_key_file }}", mode: '0600' }

    - name: Create document root directory
      file:
        path: "{{ document_root }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"

    - name: Deploy Nginx configuration
      template:
        src: nginx.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        backup: yes
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify: restart nginx

    - name: Create sample index page
      template:
        src: index.html.j2
        dest: "{{ document_root }}/index.html"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Configure UFW firewall
      ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "{{ item }}"
        proto: tcp
      loop: "{{ firewall_allowed_ports }}"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Enable UFW firewall
      ufw:
        state: enabled
        policy: deny
        direction: incoming
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Validate Nginx configuration
      command: nginx -t
      register: nginx_syntax
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: nginx_syntax.rc != 0

    - name: Start and enable Nginx
      systemd:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: yes

  handlers:
    - name: restart nginx
      systemd:
        name: nginx
        state: restarted

  post_tasks:
    - name: Verify web server is responding
      uri:
        url: "https://{{ server_name }}"
        method: GET
        validate_certs: no
        timeout: 10
      delegate_to: localhost
      register: web_response
      failed_when: web_response.status != 200

    - name: Display deployment summary
      debug:
        msg: |
          =================================
          Web Server Deployment Complete!
          =================================
          Server: {{ inventory_hostname }}
          URL: https://{{ server_name }}
          SSL: Enabled (self-signed)
          Status: {{ web_response.status }}
          =================================
